blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 23 contains 21 verses. It opens with: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him. It concludes with: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. And Athaliah they had slain with the sword.
